events.text: Governor Noah cuts the tax on the rich in Goldcoast from 30% to 24%.
Governor Nova raises free money for all in Liberty Bay from 0% to 3% of typical pay.

Governor Noah cuts business tax in Goldcoast from 15% to 11%.

Governor Nova boosts spending in Liberty Bay: new building projects worth 4% of the economy.
Governor Nova raises help for the poor in Liberty Bay from 3% to 5% of typical pay.
Harvests fail, and the shared forest and lake shrink by 30%. Prices start climbing.
Governor Bolt raises healthcare spending in Freeland from 25 to 31 out of 100.

Governor Noah wins the election in Goldcoast with 58% of the vote.

Prices in Liberty Bay are rising 22% a year.

Prices in Goldcoast are rising 23% a year.
The shared forest and lake are down to 26%. People take more than grows back.
Governor Bolt loses the election in Freeland with 40% of the vote.
Governor Bolt accepts defeat in Freeland and hands over power.
Governor Raj replaces Bolt in Freeland after the election.
Governor Nova wins re-election in Liberty Bay with 51% of the vote.
Governor Nova hits the term limit and steps down in Liberty Bay.
Governor Chip, another AI, replaces Nova in Liberty Bay after the election.
Governor Noah loses the election in Goldcoast with 46% of the vote.
Governor Noah accepts defeat in Goldcoast and hands over power.
